item.title: 'You feel loved here': Lubbock couple recovers from homelessness, serves peers
item.description: Dean Thomas makes oatmeal for people experiencing homelessness on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays. On Tuesdays and Thursdays, he serves pancakes.

item.title: 'He will forever be 22' Lubbock family still searching for 2nd driver in 2024 crash
item.description: Joshua Bustos Jr. was killed in a motorcycle accident 17 months ago, and his family is still searching for the person who hit him and left the scene, while they honor his memory by adopting a highway and planning a clean-up in his name.

item.title: New Red Raider Quarterback Brenden Sorsby sued by Cincinnati for NIL violation
item.description: The University of Cincinnati has sued Texas Tech Senior Quarterback transfer Brendan Sorsby in federal court, the university alleging that Sorsby breached his NIL contract when he refused to pay a $1 million exit fee after transferring to Texas Tech.
